name: io.github.Strom-Capital/mcp-server-db2i
title: IBM DB2 for i
description: Read-only SQL queries and schema inspection for IBM Db2 for i over ODBC, JT400 or Mapepire (SSH).

environmentVariables.name: DB2I_HOSTNAME
environmentVariables.description: IBM i hostname or IPv4 address

environmentVariables.name: DB2I_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: Path to a YAML file of IBM i systems. When set, it replaces the DB2I_* connection variables

environmentVariables.name: QUERY_ALLOWED_SCHEMAS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated schemas the server may read. Empty disables the check.

environmentVariables.name: DB2I_DRIVER
environmentVariables.description: Database driver: odbc (default, IBM i Access ODBC driver, no Java), jt400 (optional node-jt400 package, needs a JDK at install and a JRE at runtime) or mapepire (Mapepire over SSH, needs Java on the IBM i only)

environmentVariables.name: DB2I_JDBC_OPTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Extra JT400 JDBC properties, semicolon-separated (jt400 and mapepire drivers)

environmentVariables.name: DB2I_ODBC_OPTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Extra IBM i Access ODBC connection keywords, semicolon-separated (odbc driver)

environmentVariables.name: DB2I_MAPEPIRE_OPTIONS
environmentVariables.description: SSH and Mapepire settings, semicolon-separated, e.g. hostKey=SHA256:...;maxJobs=2 (mapepire driver)
